projects.name: Spearhead
projects.phase: PT1.5 tested at the Ankara meetup: last-day hover sank even at 100% throttle (~2.3 m/s landing, mud absorbed it, no major airframe damage). No single cause — motor saturation + CW/CCW yaw imbalance, ~8.2 V sag (cold pack, almost no ground run), +4.5–5 kg on already-underpowered KDE lift motors
projects.milestone: Decided Oct 21 (Option C): Alperen brings the MAD motors + ESCs to Turkey after his US trip, swaps them in and reflies late Nov (may add a more capable KDE pusher for transition). PT2 continues in parallel — PCB work started, main tubes likely 30 mm sq × 2 m pending transition data; PT2 build Dec. Documentation sprint: Alperen's doc list Fri Oct 23, then daily agent cross-check iterations. Zeynep's FDM/SITL/Flight Deck update up as PR #31
projects.blocker: Option C depends on getting the motors through customs · yaw-imbalance root cause unconfirmed (boom bending vs worn motors/ESCs) · documentation ~2 months behind, agents holding inconsistent assumptions

projects.name: Caribou

CBC firmware v0.1.0 + standard param file merged Oct 15. Chassis partly disassembled, CNC tube connectors + CF sandwich panels in progress; pre-November work in issues #58–68 (KBM: landing gear #60)
projects.milestone: PT1.5 build around the November US meetup · fastener sourcing (US McMaster / EU Würth) list sent to Julius Oct 17 · CMAIN CAN connector layout revision (#68)
projects.blocker: PR #71 KiCad ERC/DRC not yet run (pending Julius) · PT1 operation still gated on LBA authorization (submitted Aug 18, no news as of Oct 7) · tuning changes need a flight test
